About

Hi, I’m Taani

Hi, I’m Taani, the home cook behind Cook At First Sight. I share modern Indian recipes that are high-protein, healthy, and ready in about 30 minutes — easy Indian food for busy days. I’m based in California and create recipes, reels, and food content for a community of 63,000+ home cooks who love Indian food made simple.

  • High-protein twists on the Indian dishes you already love
  • Easy, uncomplicated recipes — nothing fussy, ever
  • Festive recipes and campaign content for every celebration

Most loved

Recipes people come back for

The one that started it all: Fiery Garlic Murmura — a crunchy, fiery puffed-rice snack that reached 97K likes and is still the most-loved recipe on the page.

Her Cashew Date Protein Cups are another community favourite at 64.1K likes — the same idea in sweet form: a traditional treat, reworked to be high-protein and simple.

New recipes land on Instagram @cookatfirstsight and as Shorts on YouTube.
